notes: CORRECTION: the sketch printed 'Base' because index 0 = pin D3, but the servo physically wired to D3 was the GRIPPER/CLAW. Index selects a PIN, not a motor. First confirmed movement. Root cause of earlier no-motion: MISSING COMMON GROUND (Arduino GND to supply negative). Powered from 6.6V Kids II S005VU0600070 via breadboard. No board reset. CAUTION: if this is an MG90S its max is 6.0V and the supply measures 6.62V - over spec, see V2 doc.
